data.long_meaning: The name Ailani is of Hawaiian origin and means 'mountain flower'. This name is often given to girls born in Hawaii and is a beautiful and meaningful name for any child. The name Ailani carries the meaning “Mountain flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ailani usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
